description: Repo-scale (ruby-eventboard): add an atomic all-or-nothing bulk RSVP cancellation method
prompts: Add `RsvpService#bulk_cancel(rsvp_ids)`. It must validate the WHOLE batch before canceling anything: raise RsvpError (and cancel NOTHING) if `rsvp_ids` is empty, or if ANY id in it does not reference an existing RSVP, or references one that's already canceled - even one bad id anywhere in the list must leave every RSVP's status completely unchanged, not just the ones after the bad id. Only once every id is confirmed valid should the whole batch actually be canceled (reusing the existing per-RSVP `cancel` logic, including its waitlist-promotion behavior). Returns the array of canceled RSVPs.

test_setup_files.test/bulk_cancel_test.rb:
require_relative "test_helper"

class BulkCancelTest < Minitest::Test
  include EventBoardTestSetup

  def test_bulk_cancel_applies_all_when_every_id_is_valid
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 5)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")
    r1 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a1.id)
    r2 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a2.id)

    canceled = service.bulk_cancel([r1.id, r2.id])
    assert_equal 2, canceled.length
    assert_equal "canceled", rsvps.find(r1.id).status
    assert_equal "canceled", rsvps.find(r2.id).status
  end

  def test_bulk_cancel_rejects_whole_batch_on_one_bad_id
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 5)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    r1 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a1.id)

    assert_raises(EventBoard::RsvpError) { service.bulk_cancel([r1.id, 999_999]) }

    assert_equal "confirmed", rsvps.find(r1.id).status
  end

  def test_bulk_cancel_promotes_waitlisted_like_single_cancel
    events, attendees, rsvps, service = build_service
    event = events.create(title: "Meetup", capacity: 1)
    a1 = attendees.create(name: "A", email: "a@example.com")
    a2 = attendees.create(name: "B", email: "b@example.com")
    r1 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a1.id)
    r2 = service.register(event_id: event.id, attendee_id: a2.id)
    assert_equal "waitlisted", r2.status

    service.bulk_cancel([r1.id])
    assert_equal "confirmed", rsvps.find(r2.id).status
  end
end

reference_solution.lib/event_board/rsvp_service.rb:
module EventBoard
  class RsvpError < StandardError; end

  class RsvpService
    def initialize(events:, attendees:, rsvps:)
      @events = events
      @attendees = attendees
      @rsvps = rsvps
    end

    def register(event_id:, attendee_id:)
      event = @events.find(event_id)
      raise RsvpError, "event not found" unless event
      raise RsvpError, "attendee not found" unless @attendees.find(attendee_id)

      status = confirmed_count(event_id) < event.capacity ? "confirmed" : "waitlisted"
      @rsvps.create(event_id: event_id, attendee_id: attendee_id, status: status, created_at: Time.now.to_f)
    end

    def cancel(rsvp_id)
      rsvp = @rsvps.find(rsvp_id)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp not found" unless rsvp
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp already canceled" if rsvp.status == "canceled"

      was_confirmed = rsvp.status == "confirmed"
      rsvp.status = "canceled"

      if was_confirmed
        next_waiting = @rsvps.for_event(rsvp.event_id).select { |r| r.status == "waitlisted" }.min_by(&:id)
        next_waiting.status = "confirmed" if next_waiting
      end

      rsvp
    end

    # Cancels a batch of RSVPs atomically: every id must exist and not
    # already be canceled BEFORE any of them are actually canceled - one
    # bad id anywhere in the batch leaves every RSVP untouched.
    def bulk_cancel(rsvp_ids)
      raise RsvpError, "rsvp_ids must be non-empty" if rsvp_ids.nil? || rsvp_ids.empty?

      rsvp_ids.each do |id|
        rsvp = @rsvps.find(id)
        raise RsvpError, "rsvp_ids must all reference existing, not-yet-canceled rsvps" if rsvp.nil? || rsvp.status == "canceled"
      end

      rsvp_ids.map { |id| cancel(id) }
    end

    private

    def confirmed_count(event_id)
      @rsvps.for_event(event_id).count { |r| r.status == "confirmed" }
    end
  end
end
